pathogen.value: reticuloendotheliosis virus (REV), a group of avian retroviruses

value: long-term tumors of the lymphoid and other tissues

summary.value: Reticuloendotheliosis is a group of syndromes in chickens and other poultry caused by an avian retrovirus, showing up as stunted growth or as tumors of the lymphoid and reticulum cells. It is grouped alongside Marek's disease and avian leukosis as one of the main viral tumor diseases of birds.
